🆕 New (Published: August 12, 2026)

Following the issuance of a landslide hazard warning at 6:07 p.m. today, self-evacuation shelters have been opened at the following locations: Kaji District Administrative Center, Kaji-Higashi District Administrative Center, Agano District Administrative Center, Haraichiba District Administrative Center, and Naguri District Administrative Center.

※ Self-evacuation shelters do not provide food, daily necessities, or other supplies as a general rule.

If you evacuate, please bring the minimum necessary items with you in advance.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/11997.html
